claim_boundary: functional, cycle-accurate RTL simulation of a layer-per-package array of decode cores; package control (ot_rom_pkg_ctrl) and the switch (ot_rom_fabric_router) are synthesizable RTL, the memories are behavioural and the package link's PHY is a delay-line stand-in (ot_rom_pkg_link: 60 cycles point-to-point, 30 per switch half-link). All users share the oracle's one prompt.
